test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

I began with writing one a week and now I do so every day.

options.text: now I do so every day.

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is "one a week''.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part "one a week"
 
• The phrase "one a week" is incorrect because it should be "once a week."
 
• "Once" is an adverb meaning "one time" or "on one occasion."
 
• "One" is a determiner or pronoun indicating a single entity.
 
• To correct the error, replace "one" with "once."
 
• "Once a week" means "one time per week," which fits the intended meaning of the sentence.

 

 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: I began with writing*** once a week, **__and now I do so every day.*
